name: Stéphane Debac
biography: Stéphane Debac (born 23 October 1973) is a French actor, who played as 'Albert Mulveau' in the French TV series Résistance. He was born on 23 October 1973 in Lyon, France. Debac has appeared in several French films. Source: Article "Stéphane Debac" from Wikipedia in English, licensed under CC-BY-SA 3.0.
